images.caption: Evening rush hour on I-395 and Route 27, with the Pentagon in the background. This is looking north from the intersection of Lynn Street and Army Navy Drive. In the foreground is the ramp from I-395 north, Route 27 east and Arlington Ridge Road to I-395 north (no sign) and Hayes Street (to US 1 south). Behind is Route 27 east, with the ramp from I-395 north merging in on the right. After crossing under I-395 are two exits - the first for the Pentagon (south parking) and the second for Route 244. Beyond that, Route 27 heads towards the Arlington Memorial Bridge. The sign in the background is on I-395's reversible HOV lane, saying that the next exit (Eads Street) leads to the Pentagon. Taken on October 27, 2005 by Kmf164
